title: Down-the-middle isometries for the Airy and KPZ sheets
summary: We find a new coupling between the Airy sheet $\mathcal{S}$ and the Airy line ensemble $\{ \mathcal{A}_n \}_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$, which we call the down-the-middle isometry. In this coupling, the Airy sheet is encoded by last passage values that start at $\mathcal{A}_k(0)$ for some $k \in \mathbb{N}$ and end on the top line $\mathcal{A}_1$. Using this coupling, we give a new construction of the (extended) Airy sheet as a scaling limit of Brownian last passage percolation and study coalescence of geodesics in the directed landscape.
